description: This file defines a class 'ImageAspectRatio' that extends an abstract validator rule to check if an image's aspect ratio matches a specified value, with special handling for SVG images. It is part of the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system, specifically within the 'CorporateBranding' plugin API validation rules.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatio
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an input image's aspect ratio matches a predefined ratio, allowing for SVG images and tolerances.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the target aspect ratio for validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the input based on aspect ratio, considering SVG exceptions and applying the tolerance from Theme.
